MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive bar magnets felt useful for holding small workshop items, which connects directly to the storage purpose of my recent magnetic hooks.",
    "The small magnets recognized some of my interest in magnetic holding accessories, although their tiny size and large pack did not give me a clear reason to buy them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The fishing magnet shares a material with my hooks, but retrieving objects from water serves a different purpose from organizing workshop items.",
    "The electrical connectors and heat shrink tubing require a wiring project I do not currently have; buying nuts, bolts, and washers does not establish that need.",
    "The grinding discs require tool compatibility I have not established, while the test kit and thousand-pack of gloves address needs I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in magnetic hooks seemed to be treated as interest in magnets of any size or purpose.",
    "My purchases of practical fasteners seemed to be stretched into a broad interest in electrical repair and other workshop consumables."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection is how an item helps me mount, hold, or organize things, rather than simply whether it contains magnets.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear current use, so dimensions, compatibility, and a usable quantity matter even when the general item interests me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in practical magnetic storage but extended it to supplies whose purpose, size, or quantity did not fit my current needs."
}
